title: Laredo Animal Care Services: Adopt, Foster, Save Lives
excerpt: Laredo Animal Care Services is putting out the call to adopt, foster, or volunteer, saying the real mission is clear: adopt, foster, save lives.
content:
Laredo Animal Care Services is putting out the call to adopt, foster, or volunteer, saying the real mission is clear: adopt, foster, save lives.

In a post on Friday, Nov. 20, the shelter invited the community to come meet a new best friend — or lend a hand as a volunteer. Fostering, the shelter said, saves lives.

The post used a Grand Theft Auto VI theme, calling adoption a side quest worth taking on: pull up, adopt, and give a shelter pet a home.

Source: Laredo Animal Care Services, Nov. 20, 2026.
